setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 1500
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (3, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, n)

steps.name: enable 2×2 grid with score on panel 1
steps.eval: const scoreCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'score'); a.setGridLayout('2x2'); a.toggleGrid(); a.setPanelColorColumn(1, scoreCol.index)
